description: This file contains functions for interacting with MTD devices on I-O DATA hardware, including reading/writing bytes, setting flags, and preparing the environment. It appears to be part of a firmware upgrade utility designed specifically for MSTC (MitraStar Technology Corp.) devices within the OpenWrt project.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure in environment check by rebooting the device.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_rw_byte
methods.description: Reads or writes a single byte at a specified offset in an MTD device.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_set_flag
methods.description: Sets a specific flag in an MTD device, with validation and error handling.
